entry.title: Shooter dead and multiple injured in shooting at Oregon elementary school

media:group.media:title: Shooter dead and multiple injured in shooting at Oregon elementary school

entry.title: Why the Houthis are ramping up their attacks on Saudi Arabia

media:group.media:title: Why the Houthis are ramping up their attacks on Saudi Arabia
media:group.media:description:
Several Houthi missiles and drones struck the presidential Al-Maashiq Palace in Aden, killing two members of Prime Minister Shaya Al-Zindani’s security detail, Yemen’s internationally recognized government said Thursday.
The Iran-aligned rebels claimed they were targeting an alleged Saudi military operations center inside the compound. A Saudi-led military coalition has backed the government in its long fight against the rebel group.
The Houthis claimed Thursday’s strike was part of a declared strategy of targeting Saudi military deployments wherever they are located.

entry.title: Lawyer unpacks judge's ruling limiting DOJ access to Ilhan Omar's records

media:group.media:title: Lawyer unpacks judge's ruling limiting DOJ access to Ilhan Omar's records
media:group.media:description:
The Trump administration pushed for an unusually aggressive search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s house in recent days in an immigration fraud probe that targets the congresswoman, possible false statements made on government documents, and a potential conspiracy, according to multiple people familiar with the investigation.
Prosecutors, however, first had to contend with a federal magistrate judge, in a prolonged back-and-forth that hasn’t previously been reported. Judge Matthew Sharbaugh of the DC District Court ultimately limited how the Justice Department could access Omar’s documents in Monday’s search, before he would approve the warrant, because of her role as a member of Congress and the Constitutional protections that affords, multiple people familiar with the investigation told CNN.

entry.title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot missiles as Zelensky feels betrayed by Trump

media:group.media:title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot missiles as Zelensky feels betrayed by Trump
media:group.media:description:
Ukraine has run out of missiles for the US-made Patriot air defense system, leaving it more vulnerable to Russian ballistic missile attacks, a source familiar with the situation told CNN on Thursday.
The stark development comes amid an increasingly bitter public feud between US President Donald Trump and his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky. In recent days, the White House struck a highly criticized deal to import Russian diesel and heaped increasing pressure on Ukraine to halt its strikes on Russia’s oil infrastructure. Zelensky said he felt betrayed by Trump’s deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin and has since announced Ukraine would continue striking Russian refineries.

entry.title: 'Absolutely stunning': Enten unpacks Trump's dismal new Fox poll

media:group.media:title: 'Absolutely stunning': Enten unpacks Trump's dismal new Fox poll
media:group.media:description:
President Donald Trump’s approval rating has hit its lowest point in Fox News polling across his two terms in office just weeks before a critical midterm election gauges voter reaction to his party’s performance in control of Washington over the past two years, according to a new national poll.
CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten unpacks the new numbers, observing that "more Americans who think that we faked the moon landing than the percentage of young voters who actually approve of the job that Trump is doing on inflation," adding that "these numbers are some of the worst I have ever seen in any poll on any issue for any president." CNN's Alayna Treene reports on the new poll as well, and Semafor's Shelby Talcott reacts.
